title: Cap. IX Arg. 12 Sol: we add what they hide — God wills hearers saved if they believe, yet wills not to soften all so they believe; pray for all, treat none as reprobate
pass_a_gloss: But this we add, which they by obstinate silence desire to hide: that God, who wills to save all hearing the Gospel if they believe, if by their own pertinacity they by no means oppose themselves, yet wills not to have mercy on all unto this point that they be softened, and believe, and by their own pertinacity do not oppose themselves, but on the elect only; but wills to permit that others by their own fault be hardened, and remain in their voluntary pertinacity. But because it is unknown unto us of whom he wills to have mercy, and whom he wills to leave unto his own hardness, it is ours to pray for all, that they be converted, and to hold no one singularly for a reprobate.
pass_b_english: But we add what they by obstinate silence wish to hide. God wills to save all who hear the Gospel if they believe and their own pertinacity does not hinder them. Yet he does not will to have mercy on all so far that they are softened, believe, and cease to hinder themselves — but on the elect only. He wills to permit that others by their own fault be hardened and remain in voluntary pertinacity. Because it is unknown to us of whom he wills to have mercy, and whom he wills to leave to their own hardness, it is ours to pray for all that they be converted, and to treat no one in particular as reprobate.
source_text: At hoc nos addimus, quod illi obstinato silentio cupiunt occultare, Deum, qui vult omnes Evangelium audientes servare si credant, si sua pertinacia sibi minime obsint, non velle tamen omnium eousque misereri ut emolliantur, et credant, et sua pertinacia sibi non obsint, sed electorum tantum; velle autem permittere ut alii suo vitio indurentur, et in sua voluntaria pertinacia permaneant. Quia vero nobis incognitum est cujus vult misereri, et quem vult suae duritiae relinquere, nostrum est pro omnibus orare, ut convertantur, et neminem singulariter pro reprobato habere.
